It went through a Chapter 11 restructuring in 2025 and emerged with debt largely converted to equity. Customers include automakers and power electronics firms. Listed on the NYSE (WOLF). B2B semiconductor supplier with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Wolfspeed
wiki.text: Wolfspeed, Inc. is an American developer and manufacturer of wide-bandgap semiconductors, focused on silicon carbide materials and devices for power applications such as transportation, power supplies, power inverters, and wireless systems. The company was formerly named Cree, Inc.

Founded in 2012, it serves tens of thousands of partners globally and is valued at over 1 billion dollars after investment from Blackstone and others. wiki.title: List of Tetris variants
wiki.text: This is a list of variants of the game Tetris. It also includes officially licensed Tetris sequels, as well as unofficial clones. In 2017 Guinness World Records reported Tetris to be the game with most official versions released, at 220, over 65 different platforms.

about: Axway is an API management and managed file transfer software company, with its French roots and a US base in Scottsdale, Arizona. Its platform helps enterprises, banks and governments integrate systems, exchange data securely and publish APIs, and it has thousands of customers worldwide. It is listed on Euronext Paris (AXW) and was formerly a unit of Sopra, with Sopra Steria still a major shareholder. Revenue is near EUR 300M. B2B software brand with no consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Axway Software
wiki.text: Axway Software is a French-American publicly held information technology company that provides software tools for enterprise software, enterprise application integration, business activity monitoring, business analytics, mobile application development and web API management.

about: Pivot3 was a hyperconverged infrastructure company that supplied integrated storage and computing systems, especially for video surveillance, to enterprises and governments. It was based in Austin, Texas, with Colorado listed in the input, and its assets were acquired by Quantum Corporation in 2021. It was a B2B technology brand known to IT and security integrators, with no consumer visibility. It is no longer an independent company.

Xtera was a McKinney, Texas network equipment and services company that sold subsea and terrestrial optical transmission systems, including Raman-amplified long-haul and unrepeatered undersea networks, to telecom operators and energy companies. It filed for bankruptcy and was acquired by Infinera in 2017. It was a B2B telecom brand with no consumer profile and is now defunct. Its customers were carriers and operators of subsea cables.

India's largest staffing and business services company, based in Bangalore and founded by Ajit Isaac, with operations in general staffing, IT staffing, facility management, security services and logistics. Customers are thousands of enterprises across sectors, and it places or manages several hundred thousand workers. Brands within the group include Quess IT Staffing, Conneqt, Allsec and Terrier Security Services. It is listed on the NSE and BSE, and Fairfax-linked Thomas Cook India originally founded and controlled it. Largely B2B with limited consumer recognition, though the name is known in Indian HR circles.

DBS Bank is Southeast Asia's largest bank, offering consumer, SME and corporate banking, wealth management and digital banking (digibank) in Singapore, Hong Kong, China, India and Indonesia. Revenue near 22 billion Singapore dollars. Headquartered in Singapore; founded 1968; Singapore state investor Temasek holds about 29 percent of parent DBS Group Holdings. Listed on the Singapore Exchange (D05). Strong consumer brand in Singapore, and a sponsor of sports and marathons.

wiki.title: DBS Bank
wiki.what: Singaporean multinational banking and financial services company
wiki.text: DBS Bank Limited is a Singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation headquartered at the Marina Bay Financial Centre in the Marina Bay district of Singapore. The bank was previously known as The Development Bank of Singapore Limited, which "DBS" was derived from, before the present abbreviated name was adopted on 21 July 2003 to reflect its role as a global bank. It is one of the "Big Three" local banks in Singapore, along with Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation (OCBC) and United Overseas Bank (UOB).

about: FIS (Fidelity National Information Services) is a Jacksonville, Florida fintech that provides banking and payments technology, including core banking systems, card processing, merchant acquiring and capital markets software for banks, credit unions, corporates and merchants worldwide. It employs about 50,000 people and generates revenue near $10bn. Listed on the NYSE (FIS). It bought Global Payments' issuer business in 2025 and sold much of Worldpay. B2B, widely known in financial circles though not to consumers.

wiki.title: FIS (company)
wiki.text: Fidelity National Information Services, Inc. (FIS) is an American financial technology company headquarterd in Jacksonville, Florida, which focuses on core banking, payments and capital markets. Annually, FIS facilitates the movement of roughly US$9 trillion through the processing of approximately 75 billion transactions in service to more than 20,000 clients around the globe.

about: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria (BBVA) is a Bilbao and Madrid-based Spanish bank with large operations in Mexico (BBVA Mexico), Turkey (Garanti BBVA), Spain and South America, serving about 80 million customers. Listed on the Madrid exchange and NYSE (BBVA). It owns the digital bank brand and has total assets above 800 billion euros. Very high consumer brand awareness in Spain and Mexico, with sports sponsorship including LaLiga and Liga MX.

wiki.title: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria
wiki.text: Banco Bilbao Vizcaya Argentaria, S.A., better known by its initialism BBVA, is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Bilbao, with operative offices in Madrid. As one of the largest financial institutions globally, BBVA's core markets are primarily concentrated in Spain, Mexico, South America, and Turkey.

about: Blue Owl Capital is a New York-based alternative asset manager listed on the NYSE (OWL), formed in 2021 through a SPAC merger of Owl Rock and Dyal Capital. It manages well over 200 billion dollars across direct lending, GP strategic capital, and real assets such as net lease and digital infrastructure including data centres. Clients are institutions, insurers and wealthy individuals, and it earns management and performance fees. Blue Owl has taken sports-related stakes in minority team-ownership funds. B2B financial brand with low consumer awareness.
